paper.title: Do DESI-DR2 BAO data imply a coupling of dark matter and dark energy?

paper_specifications.continuity_convention: dot(rho_x) + 3 H (1+w_x) rho_x = Q; dot(rho_c) + 3 H rho_c = -Q
paper_specifications.sign: Gamma > 0 transfers energy CDM -> DE; Gamma < 0 transfers DE -> CDM
paper_specifications.ivs_perturbations: In synchronous gauge, delta_c' = -(theta_c + h'/2) + Gamma*a*(rho_x/rho_c)*delta_c; theta_c' = -Hcal*theta_c; vacuum DE has no perturbative contribution.
perturbation_assumptions: no momentum transfer in the DM rest frame
paper_specifications.method_text: modified CAMB + Cobaya MCMC; Gelman-Rubin convergence diagnosis; GetDist for chains

not_specified_in_public_paper_text: modified CAMB repository/fork, patch identifier, release or commit
exact IVS sampling YAML/run configuration and convergence threshold
version/hash of the DES-Dovekie likelihood implementation
explicit IVS perturbation initial-condition prescription or initial numerical values
paper.post_v1_check: arXiv submission history displayed only v1 during this audit. APS listed the accepted paper but exposed no software supplement; its page says any author supplements will be available upon publication of the version of record.

paper_cited_repository.role_as_cited: Reference [157], in the paragraph about the Cobaya interface used for MCEvidence; paper does not identify it as the modified-CAMB source.
artifact_assessment: No IVS/interacting CAMB patch or fork path was present in the pinned tree; only a generic CAMB introductory notebook was CAMB-named.
No Dovekie-specific likelihood or IVS Cobaya config/model YAML was present in the pinned tree.
The generic SN YAML listed sn.desy5, sn.union3, sn.pantheonplus, and sn.pantheonplusshoes; custom SN likelihood paths were PantheonPlus variants.
The repository README characterizes its contents as a personal/research subset; yamls/README.md says the Cobaya YAMLs are mainly collected for personal organization.
The MCMC_Evidence/Cobaya_wrapper.py file is an evidence utility and does not identify the paper's cosmology theory patch or likelihood configuration.
The repository HEAD predates arXiv v1. Although repository metadata updated_at is 2026-09-07, the API exposed no later branch head/commit, tag, or release.

conclusion: Exact implementation-level reproduction artifacts (modified CAMB version, full run config/dependency versions, Dovekie likelihood version, perturbation initial conditions) remain unresolved. No inference is made that unlinked or private code does not exist.
gate_recommendation: Do not use the paper as an implementation-level validation target until the missing artifacts are recovered. A separately specified background-only profile may be run only as a distinct analysis, not described as reproducing the paper's full perturbative analysis.
